comment: botl.c compare_blstats() for BL_TERRAIN. A xorn (wizard-mode #polyself) walks from the up stairs into the room's west wall, down to the south-west corner, and east along the south wall to the south-east corner and the rock beyond, with terrainstatus and a 'changed' rule on terrain. compare_blstats() means to compare BL_TERRAIN as the terrain_typ number, but init_blstats() fills blstats[][j] from initblstats[j], and blstats[][BL_TERRAIN] is the armor entry, so the cheat's bl1->fld == BL_TERRAIN test fails and the field compares with strcmp(). The recorder therefore highlights only Stairs->Wall and Wall->Stone, not the moves between wall types that share the text "Wall"; a port that compares the number fails this recording.
